name: CUTLASS: CUDA Templates and Python DSLs for High-Performance Linear Algebra
notes: CUTLASS 4.8.0 (Sept 2026). Collection of abstractions for high-performance GEMM and related computations. Supports FP64, FP32, TF32, FP16, BF16, FP8 (e5m2/e4m3), block-scaled (NVFP4, MXFP4/6/8), narrow integer (4b, 8b), binary (1b). Covers Volta through Blackwell. v4 adds CuTe DSL (Python DSL). 10.5k stars. Essential for custom kernel development.
